## 💡 Feature Overview
A clear and concise description of what feature or tool you would like to see.

## 🎯 Problem It Solves
Is your feature request related to a problem or bottleneck? Ex. "I'm always frustrated when..."

## 🛠️ Proposed Solution / API Design
Describe how you envision the feature working:
* New tool name (e.g. `extra_...`)
* Arguments & return signature
* Win32 API or subsystem leveraged

## ⚖️ Architectural Invariants Verification
- [ ] Conforms to Zero Solo Binary Blobs (pure ctypes / PSF / Microsoft packages only)
- [ ] Complies with `PerMonitorV2` DPI scaling
- [ ] Avoids unnecessary visual screenshot overhead where UIA or fast-path is possible

## 📋 Additional Context
Add any other context, mockups, or screenshots about the feature request here.
